# SAD amendment sample

A simulated amendment used to demonstrate amendment monitoring on the SAD trial.

- `NCT07347678_v1.txt`: the live ClinicalTrials.gov criteria snapshot fetched 2026-10-09 (also at `data/snapshots/NCT07347678/`).
- `NCT07347678_v2.txt`: v1 with two hand edits: SAD LDL-C threshold 70 -> 100 mg/dL (substantive) and the HbA1c line reworded (wording).
- `sad-1.0.1-sample.json`: `sad-1.0.0.json` with I2 `lower` 70 -> 100; nothing else changed.
